{{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Ground |type2=Dragon |trainername=Goh |pokemonname=Flygon |jtrainername=ゴウ |jpokemonname=フライゴン |tmtrainername=Go |tmpokemonname=Flygon |image=[[File:Goh Flygon.png|250px]] |caption=Goh's Flygon |prevonum=330 |epnum=JN036 |epname=Making Battles in the Sand! |location=[[Mauville City]] |current=[[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]] |gender=Unknown |ability=Unknown |noevo=incap |java1=[[Risa Shimizu]] |enva1= }} '''Goh's Flygon''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのフライゴン''' ''Go's Flygon'') is the eighth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]], and his sixty-second overall. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== [[File:JN040.png|thumb|250px|left|Flygon and Raboot battling Zapdos]] In ''[[JN036|Making Battles in the Sand!]]'', Goh first encountered Flygon when he and {{Ash}} were investigating a Sandstorm that had hit [[Mauville City]]. Goh attempted to catch it, but Flygon dodges all of the {{i|Poké Ball}}s, forcing Ash and Goh to battle it. Ash attempted to battle Flygon with {{AP|Pikachu}} before remembering that as a {{t|Ground}} type, Flygon was [[Type#Type effectiveness|immune]] to its {{type|Electric}} attacks, causing Ash to use {{AP|Riolu}} instead. Flygon put up a tough fight, managing to defeat Riolu and {{TP|Goh|Sobble}} before being defeated by {{TP|Goh|Raboot}}, allowing Goh to catch it. In ''[[JN040|A Crackling Raid Battle!]]'', Goh sent out Flygon to assist in a [[Raid Battle (GO)#In animation|Raid Battle]] against {{p|Zapdos}}. It later teamed up with Raboot, causing serious damage. Despite this, Zapdos was able to avoid being captured. In ''[[JN071|Leaping Toward the Dream!]]'', Goh used Flygon to find an {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Ninetales}} as part of his quest for [[Project Mew]]. In ''[[JN084|An Adventure of Mega Proportions!]]'', while traveling to [[Mega Island]] in search of a [[Lucarionite]], Goh used Flygon as a means of transport for himself and {{an|Korrina}}. However, during a battle between a {{p|Pidgeot}} and a {{p|Salamence}}, the group broke up and landed next to a lava fountain created by the flames of a {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Camerupt}}. This disoriented Flygon, forcing Goh to call it back. In ''[[JN090|Showdown at the Gates of Warp!]]'', Flygon [[Devolution|devolved]] into {{p|Vibrava}}, then {{p|Trapinch}}, and finally an {{pkmn|Egg}} as a result of a clash between {{OBP|Dialga|recurring}} and {{OBP|Palkia|recurring}} distorting time. After {{p|Arceus}} stopped the fight between Dialga and Palkia, the {{pkmn|category|Temporal and Spatial Pokémon}} repaired the distortions their fighting had caused and restored all the devolved Pokémon back to normal. In ''[[JN113|Chasing to the Finish!]]'', Goh used Flygon to battle {{p|Regieleki}} and {{p|Regidrago}} at the [[Split-Decision Ruins]], alongside {{Gary}}'s {{p|Hatterene}}, but both of them were ultimately defeated. In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Flygon joined the rest of Goh's Pokémon at the lab to celebrate their Trainer's return from the last mission of [[Project Mew]]. In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', it attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure. After that, it posed for a group photo with Goh, Ash, and the others. ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Goh and Flygon.png|thumb|250px|Flygon and Goh]] Flygon is a strong {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. In ''[[JN036|Making Battles in the Sand!]]'', it went up against {{AP|Riolu}} and {{TP|Goh|Sobble}}, defeating them both before losing to {{TP|Goh|Raboot}}. It is also one of Goh's main Pokémon for aerial support, alongside {{TP|Goh|Aerodactyl}}. As shown in its debut, it is extremely capable with sand. Using {{m|Sandstorm}}, it is able to create a sandstorm the length of half [[Mauville City|a city]] and strong enough to keep others out. It is able to burrow through sand as if it is water, boosting its offensive and defensive capabilities at the same time. The sand can also beat against Flygon's wings to create an alluring song. Flygon also has a great team spirit, using its attacks so that Raboot can battle next. It also became worried about him when Raboot was almost defeated and still insisted on battling. This protection extends to its destruction of Mauville City, as it started the sandstorm there to create a nest for itself and fellow desert-dwelling Pokémon. ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{ground color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{dragon color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{ground color light}}; {{roundytl|5px}}" | As an Egg
